title: Evaluation-Awareness Features: Does the Model Know It's Being Tested?

original_idea.body:
# Evaluation-Awareness Features: Does the Model Know It's Being Tested?

**Problem:** Models have detectable evaluation awareness; if steerable, it enables sandbagging and undermines behavioral evals. Mechanistic basis barely characterized in open models.

**Direction:** On an open chat model, build contrastive eval-vs-deployment prompt pairs, locate the feature/probe, test causality via intervention on a benchmark.

**Why it matters:** Core long-horizon threat. No training.

**Relevant context:** arXiv 2507.01786; deception-probe literature.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: eval-awareness undermines all behavioral safety evals, a recognized critical pathway; causal localization is valuable.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Contrastive probing + intervention on one open model; guided and tractable.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused (locate + test causality of one feature) though intervention adds steps.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Model-organism-style probe of a neglected long-horizon threat; open model, no training.

low_compute.reasoning: Activation extraction + intervention on an open model; single mid GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Eval-awareness probing exists; the open-model causal-feature localization may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Eval-awareness is documented; the mechanistic causal feature in open models may be open.
